items.title: Orrin Evans interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe...') and Orrin Evans as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Orrin was interviewed in Utica, New York on May 22, 2018 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Orrin Evans with me today. And you are a well-traveled performer, but I think I can safely say you’ve never been in this particular spot before.
I can agree. I mean as far as New York goes, for me, definitely the city, I’ve been to Albany and Corning, but this is my first time here.
